challenge.method: Tested whether the shared No Derivatives wording could select CC-BY-ND-2.0 instead.
challenge.results: The generated ID and URL both contain NC-ND. Section 4(b) includes commercial-advantage wording. The BY-ND detail has a different ID, path and section 4(b).

limitations: The connection between No Derivatives and NoDerivs rests on the identifier, text heading and explicit citation. It supplies no general rule of semantic equivalence, translation, adaptation or reuse. The publisher digest is an acquisition observation.
